title: Winds, Monsoons and Ocean Currents
summary: How uneven heating drives sea breezes, the monsoon, global winds and ocean currents that move heat around Earth.

cbse.chapter: Exploration (2026) Ch 13: Earth as a System: Energy, Matter and Life

objectives: I can explain how uneven heating causes winds.
I can explain the Indian monsoon.

misconceptions: Wind blows from cold places to hot places only at night.
The monsoon is just heavy rain.
Ocean water stays in one place.
